roe.method: sum(net_profit) / sum(average_equity) on the same companies

roa.method: sum(net_profit) / sum(average_assets) on the same companies

gross_margin.method: sum(gross_profit) / sum(revenue) on the same companies

net_margin.method: sum(net_profit) / sum(revenue) on the same companies

pe.method: Requires a matched capitalization/earnings or capitalization/equity cohort; company multiples are never averaged.

pb.method: Requires a matched capitalization/earnings or capitalization/equity cohort; company multiples are never averaged.

limitations: Totals describe the classified observed cohort, not the entire market.
Each ratio uses the same companies in its numerator and denominator. Coverage is metric-specific.
Rank 1 is the largest numerical value, not an investment recommendation. Percentile uses empirical midrank.
Membership is effective-dated; its historical publication vintage is not certified.
Bank loan/deposit ratio is an accounting comparison, not regulatory LDR.
